'''''Death Troopers''''' was the name of a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It depicted [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Rachi Sitra]] fighting off a horde of [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|infected]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] during the [[blackwing virus outbreak on Dathomir]].<ref name="SWG:DT" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Death Troopers'' was a painting in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DT" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The painting added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 14|Game Update 14]]," a.k.a. the [[W:c:swg:Death Troopers|"Death Troopers" update]], released on [[October 12]], [[2009]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 14: Death Troopers">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1008376|text=Game Update 14: Death Troopers}}</ref>
